title: Market Mate: choose the working experience
question: Compare the three previews. Choose one, or say what to combine or change. Concepts use labeled fixture evidence.

options.label: Research Workbench
options.thesis: Follow system state into the research evidence behind it.
options.viewport: Health strip above research runs, with an evidence inspector beside the selected run.
options.risk: Less dense than the current console; deep tables need a dedicated view.

raised.raise: Place provenance next to the claim.
Keep navigation distinct from evidence state.
Make missing and completed steps explicit.
Give the top exception structural priority.

options.label: Attention Desk
options.thesis: See what needs attention, why, and where to inspect it.
options.viewport: A ranked exception list leads beside a contextual research and custody inspector.
options.risk: A familiar professional console; quieter days need a strong research entry point.

options.label: Spectral edge
options.risk: Spectral accents compete with status colors.
options.case: Weaker fit for daily supervision and precise inspection than the workbench.

options.label: Typographic field
options.thesis: A large status word leads the register.
options.viewport: A large status word leads the register.
options.case: Weaker fit for daily supervision and precise inspection than the workbench.

options.label: Annotated reference
options.thesis: Claims and references sit side by side.
options.viewport: Claims and references sit side by side.
options.risk: Book conventions slow daily health scanning.
options.case: Weaker fit for daily supervision and precise inspection than the workbench.
options.kept: Place provenance next to the claim.

options.label: Evidence atlas
options.case: Weaker fit for daily supervision and precise inspection than the workbench.
options.kept: Keep navigation distinct from evidence state.

options.label: Cycle instrument
options.thesis: Research cycles form an inspection timeline.
options.viewport: Research cycles form an inspection timeline.
options.risk: Instrument controls could imply run authority.
options.case: Weaker fit for daily supervision and precise inspection than the workbench.
options.kept: Make missing and completed steps explicit.

options.label: Status board
options.thesis: Stacked status courses focus the exception.
options.viewport: Stacked status courses focus the exception.
options.risk: Clipped fault legends obscure exact states.
options.case: Weaker fit for daily supervision and precise inspection than the workbench.
options.kept: Give the top exception structural priority.

canonCard.label: Current Console, Refined
canonCard.thesis: Keep the overview matrix with readable text and working drill-downs.
canonCard.viewport: Four summaries above research and attention, followed by an evidence register.
canonCard.risk: Preserves familiarity, but spreads attention across more panels.
